issues.search-quote-crash: Searching the journal for a term containing an apostrophe (e.g. O'Brien) makes GET /api/journal?q= return 500 because the term is pasted into the SQL, so the Journal page shows 'Could not load the journal.' instead of the matching entry.
issues.failed-save-clears-text: On the plant detail page, when saving a new journal entry fails (e.g. a 500 from POST /api/journal), the error is shown but the typed text is cleared from the textarea.
issues.journal-page-malformed-response-shown-as: On the Journal page, when GET /api/journal (with or without a search term) returns a non-list body such as a string, the page shows an entry count and blank '–' cards instead of an error.
issues.journal-object-response-shown-as-no-matc: On the Journal page, when a search request to GET /api/journal returns a JSON object instead of a list, the page shows '0 entries match' / 'No entries match' instead of an error.
issues.detail-malformed-journal-shown-as-fake-e: On the plant detail page, when GET /api/journal?plant_id= returns a non-list body, the journal section lists blank entries dated '–' with active Edit/Delete buttons instead of an error.
issues.journal-search-hang-loading-forever: On the Journal page, when a search request hangs, the page shows 'Loading entries…' indefinitely above the previous search's results with no timeout, error or retry.
issues.journal-nav-hang-keeps-old-page: When navigating to /journal while its request hangs, the URL changes but the previous page (e.g. Plants) stays displayed with no loading indicator or error.
issues.journal-nav-link-keeps-stale-search: Clicking the Journal nav link while a search is active changes the URL to /journal without q but leaves the search box filled and the filtered results shown.
issues.stale-add-error-not-cleared: On the plant detail page, after a failed 'Add entry' save, the error message stays visible even after the form is cleared and another journal entry is successfully edited and saved.
